promise: ForkMesh lets developers collaborate on, mirror, and preserve source-code repositories across independent hosts—without relying on any single hosting provider.

usageUnits.label: active member-month
usageUnits.definition: One distinct person authorized to use a managed workspace during a calendar month.

usageUnits.label: indexed project-month
usageUnits.definition: One project kept in a managed search or discovery index during a calendar month.
usageUnits.costSource: index inventory and provider storage invoice

usageUnits.label: managed replica GiB-month
usageUnits.definition: One gibibyte of repository or artifact data retained by a ForkMesh-operated mirror for one month.

usageUnits.label: verified egress GiB
usageUnits.definition: One gibibyte served by managed mirrors through verified clone, fetch, artifact, or recovery reads.

usageUnits.label: hosted runner minute
usageUnits.definition: One minute of hosted agent or workflow execution, rounded only at the invoice-total level.
usageUnits.costSource: runner session ledger and compute invoice

usageUnits.label: priority support hour
usageUnits.definition: One hour of human incident, onboarding, migration, or administration work.

usageUnits.label: edge Worker request
usageUnits.definition: One request reported for a ForkMesh Worker by the infrastructure provider.

usageUnits.label: Durable Object request
usageUnits.definition: One Durable Object invocation reported by the infrastructure provider.

usageUnits.label: Durable Object GB-second
usageUnits.definition: One decimal gigabyte-second of Durable Object active duration reported by the infrastructure provider.

plans.name: Protocol + self-hosted
limits: No ForkMesh license, seat, repository, storage, or protocol fee.
Capacity, uptime, backups, moderation, and support are the operator's responsibility.
plans.support: Public documentation, community discussion, and reproducible issue reports; no response-time or uptime commitment.

plans.name: Hosted Free
limits: One personal account; public reading and cloning remain anonymous.
Zero managed private-workspace, reserved-replica, priority-support, or service-level entitlements.
Shared relay, discovery, and public indexing are best effort and remain subject to security, abuse, and provider-capacity safeguards.
plans.support: Community support only; incidents are prioritized for network safety and data recovery, not by response-time commitment.

plans.name: Supporter membership
limits: Funds shared public infrastructure and includes membership recognition.
Does not add a hosted capability, reserved replica, private workspace, service level, priority support, or protocol authority.
plans.support: Billing help and community support; no contracted response or resolution time.

plans.name: Pro membership
limits: One member and the currently published Pro hosted workflows where configured.
No uptime, reserved capacity, private-workspace, managed-replica, or priority-support entitlement.
Hosted workflows use bounded safety and capacity controls; this is not an unlimited infrastructure plan.
plans.support: Billing help and community product support; no contracted response or resolution time.

plans.name: Managed services
limits: No unlimited plan: active members, indexing, replicas, egress, runners, and support use the published units.
Allowances, overages, service levels, and price require real buyer interviews plus measured cost and recovery evidence before checkout opens.
plans.support: Proposed paid jobs are managed hosting, team administration, indexing, reliability, recovery, support, and infrastructure. Contracted boundaries are not available until the launch gates pass.

entitlements.capability: Use, inspect, fork, modify, and reimplement the protocol
entitlements.hostedFree: Yes; payment never changes the protocol right

entitlements.capability: Run a relay, index, mirror, client, or compatible implementation
entitlements.paidService: ForkMesh operates selected roles for the customer

entitlements.capability: Own and export Git repositories and signed collaboration records
entitlements.paidService: Same export; cancellation cannot remove the right

entitlements.capability: Shared hosted relay, discovery, and public index
entitlements.hostedFree: Best effort; no reserved capacity or SLO

entitlements.capability: Managed private workspace and team administration
entitlements.paidService: Research preview; blocked on privacy, isolation, export, and buyer validation

entitlements.capability: Managed replicas, verified recovery, and reliability commitment
entitlements.hostedFree: No reserved replica or uptime commitment
entitlements.paidService: Metered proposal; blocked on restore and service-level evidence

entitlements.capability: Human onboarding, migration, incident, and priority support
entitlements.paidService: Proposed scoped hours and contracted response boundary

commitments: A customer may clone and export canonical project data before, during, and after cancellation without buying another plan.
A managed-service launch requires a tested export into a clean self-hosted deployment and a tested restore from the exported records.
Provider account, billing, abuse, and operational logs are not presented as canonical project data.
ForkMesh will publish format changes and migration tooling; a paid service cannot add a proprietary signature requirement to protocol objects.

dataPolicy.statement: ForkMesh does not sell personal data, repository data, collaboration data, telemetry, or derived profiles, and does not use them to sell advertising.
dataPolicy.serviceUse: Data is processed only to provide, secure, support, measure, and improve the selected service, subject to the public privacy policy.
dataPolicy.analyticsConsent: Optional product analytics is disabled by default and uses only coarse allowlisted events after explicit consent.

advertising.name: ForkMesh Ads
advertising.fundedBy: An active membership level funds live ad slots; there is no separate ad billing, bidding, or pay-per-click.
advertising.whoMaySubmit: Any verified account; an approved ad runs only while its owner holds an active membership level.
advertising.measurement: aggregate daily clicks per ad and surface; no impressions, identifiers, or addresses
